ordinals.title: Art system overhaul: pixel memes, portraits, terminals, 70 new backgrounds
ordinals.finding: Creative variation was explicitly engineered through weighted layout distribution, many registered assets, anti-repeat tracking and removal of sticker vocabulary that had caused hallucinated sticker concepts. Useful anti-fixation lineage, not evidence of unscaffolded creative emergence.

ordinals.title: Genesis overhaul: RLM-only proposals, disable Code Analyzer pipeline, README warning
ordinals.finding: Code-Analyzer review pipeline was disabled, all 119 legacy proposals were purged as garbage, smaller-model generation was replaced with the main RLM, strict structured extraction/output validation was added, and documentation explicitly warned that the 8B system was not reliable enough for production self-modification. Proposal activity therefore cannot be used as usefulness evidence.

ordinals.title: Fix compulsive ideation: hallucinated rooms, hypothesis contamination, AURA spam
ordinals.finding: Hallucinated room names, irrelevant thought-to-hypothesis resolution, weak claim quality/dedup, AURA reflection spam and an experiment-ID race were corrected with valid-room grounding, semantic relevance gates, Jaccard dedup, startup cleanup, rate limiting and cursor.lastrowid.

ordinals.title: Deep audit: 19 bug fixes + remove legacy entity system
ordinals.finding: Audit exposed queue saturation/drop policy, energy runaway, threshold mismatch, inverted habituation semantics, constant workspace energy, schema mismatches, missing DB creation, disconnected gain/relay state, dead HTTP tool paths, frozen E-PQ autonomy, cold-start immune failure and dream/consolidation failures; legacy entity system was removed in favor of rooms. Source-reported counts/rates are not independently reproduced.

ordinals.title: Genesis self-authored proposals: full pipeline + Web UI + accept/reject
ordinals.finding: Self-authored proposals gained explicit user accept/reject gates, sandbox/destructivity validation and positive/negative reward signals. Human acceptance is a useful feedback event but must not become the sole objective proxy for technical validity or scientific usefulness.

ordinals.title: CI: trigger Docker builds on every main push, link badge to registry
ordinals.finding: CI was changed to rebuild CPU/CUDA/Vulkan images on every main push with dind TLS setup and bounded job timeout. Supports continuous release-surface validation.

ordinals.title: Docker badge links to Dockerfile in repo
Fix Docker badge: link to install section instead of empty registry
ordinals.finding: Documentation had linked to an empty container registry and was redirected to installation instructions. Published availability claims must be validated against real artifacts/endpoints.

ordinals.title: Replace Web UI screenshot (remove visible IP)
ordinals.finding: A published screenshot was replaced specifically to remove a visible IP address. Visual release assets require privacy/secret/operational-metadata redaction checks.

ordinals.title: Replace old desktop screenshot with current AURA + overlay view
ordinals.finding: Updated screenshot is a time-local presentation snapshot and not architecture proof.

ordinals.title: Migrate to GitLab: replace all GitHub links, visual README overhaul
ordinals.finding: Repository/download/container links and CI were migrated to GitLab. The present Level-0 source is GitHub again, so this is hosting/distribution lineage rather than current authority. Endpoint migrations need epoch/version and artifact-integrity validation.

ordinals.title: Fix Quick Start anchor link in README
Fix hypothesis truncation and confidence display bugs
ordinals.finding: Claim-extraction length limits had truncated hypotheses, while the UI displayed default 0.5 confidence on unresolved hypotheses. Capture limits were widened and confidence hidden until actual testing. Priors/defaults must not be rendered as measured evidence.

ordinals.title: Update ABOUT.md: team credits, 6-month timeline, humbler tone
ordinals.finding: Project-history documentation corrected an earlier short development timeline, broadened team attribution and softened 'empirical test/existence proof' language to an open-ended attempt. Newer corrected provenance supersedes older repository narrative, while owner-reported effort in the RAE earned-work ledger remains a separate source and is not silently reconciled here.

ordinals.title: Add Experiment Lab section to README, fix AURA drag bug in WebUI
ordinals.finding: Documentation describes an observe→hypothesize→predict→test→evaluate→revise loop and makes performance/novelty claims. The mechanism description is useful lineage; 'milliseconds', near-zero overhead and first-implementation novelty remain source assertions here.

ordinals.title: Experiment results flow into thoughts, proposals, and chat reliability
ordinals.finding: Concrete recent confirmed/refuted hypotheses were injected into hypothesis review, experiment context and deep thoughts; hypothesis-origin Genesis proposals gained evidence-derived titles/descriptions. This closes a result→cognition feedback loop but amplifies the importance of independent/relevant resolution because contaminated findings can otherwise self-reinforce. Chat also gained content dedup and bounded streaming unlock recovery.

negative_results_preserved: All 119 prior Genesis proposals were purged as garbage before the proposal pipeline was narrowed and validated.
Hallucinated rooms entered autonomous ideation until valid-room context and post-generation correction were added.
Unrelated idle thoughts could resolve hypotheses, contaminating the empirical loop until relevance gates were introduced.
AURA reflections could become repetitive spam without hourly rate limits and semantic deduplication.
Multiple reward/gating/state channels were dead, inverted, constant or disconnected while the system continued running.
An advertised container registry link was empty.
A release screenshot exposed an IP address.
Unresolved hypotheses displayed a default confidence value as though it were evidence.
Hypothesis text was truncated by extraction limits before later correction.
measurement_boundary: All source-reported proposal counts, drop rates, energy values, fix counts, performance or novelty statements remain historical source claims unless independently reproduced. This pass establishes code/diff lineage and negative-result evidence only.

earned_work.reason: No row-level conceptual-dedup audit against HISTORICAL_EARNED_WORK was performed.
